feature: Grounded in-app Ask the Training Library implementation

flows.name: Isolate the training conversation surface
steps: Evaluate general and Ask Alleato surface matching
flows.expectedOutcome: The page reuses the canonical chat while training conversations remain isolated from every other assistant surface.

flows.name: Retrieve and cite only reviewed training content
flows.expectedOutcome: The route retrieves only training_guide and training_resource chunks and every synthesized answer ends with clickable source links.

flows.name: Keep the training index current
steps: Reconcile the generated guides and published resources
Change a resource status and run the periodic refresh
flows.expectedOutcome: Unchanged documents are skipped, stale documents are removed, status drift is reconciled, and provider failures are explicit and retried.

claims.description: The training page reuses the shared chat and isolates its conversations.
Retrieval is limited to training source types with deterministic clickable citations and explicit recovery.
Indexing is idempotent, serialized, periodically refreshed, status-aware, and count-observable.
An independent reviewer approved the implementation after its three findings were corrected.
